physical.mounting-hardware: 4 x M6 cage nuts, 4 x M6 screws, 4 x M6 washers

base.description: The raceway as NavePoint ships 00404170, cover fitted.

cover-off.description: The same raceway with its snap cover off, the channel open to lay a cable in. The cover comes with the raceway, so this is an illustration and not a device type.

datasheet.title: NavePoint 2U Horizontal Plastic Cable Management Raceway 4 inches deep, Black (product page, SKU 00404170, saved 2026-11-11)

description: 2U horizontal plastic cable management raceway, NavePoint 00404170: a black plastic back plate the full 19 in wide. A channel 104.14 mm deep stands out of it, with a snap cover across it. The page lists a cable pass-through.

gaps.note: the page states no product weight and the product's own record in the page holds none; none is recorded.
gaps.wanted: a datasheet or the installation manual's weight

gaps.note: the page lists "Cable Pass Through: Yes" and shows no size or place, so no opening is drawn or declared.
gaps.wanted: the installation manual's drawing of the pass-through

gaps.note: the table says snap and the bullets say the cover rotates up and down; the format has no hinge, so the cover is one fitted plate that comes off.
gaps.wanted: the installation manual's drawing of the cover

gaps.note: the page states no cable capacity or fill, so none is recorded or estimated.
gaps.wanted: a capacity figure and the cable it is stated for

body.description: the plastic back plate with its ears

cover.description: the snap cover across the channel, shipped fitted

walls.description: the two side walls of the channel

attrs.note: page - the material, colour and the hardware in the box (four M6 cage nuts, screws and washers).

channel.note: page - "Channel Depth: 4.1\"" is 104.14 mm; the duct guide is the clear space between the two walls.

chassis.note: page - 482.6 x 88.9 x 112.01 mm from "19"L x 4.41"W x 3.5"H" (the page's L, H and W are the width, height and depth). The width is the 19 in with the ears, as a rack-face part is its ears and what hangs off them. The depth is the overall projection, cover included.

color.note: estimated - "Black". No photograph is held, so the shades are this library's render of black plastic.

front.note: estimated - the snap cover, fitted, across the channel; the walls and the plate stand behind it.

guides.note: estimated - the duct is the channel between the two walls, run across the rack; 450.0 long by 84.9 clear. The page names no fingers, so no finger pitch is stated.

left.note: estimated - the end view: the plate, the two walls and the cover's face. The right is the same, turned round.

method.note: FIGURES FROM A PRODUCT PAGE, NO DRAWING. NavePoint publishes no datasheet or drawing for this part; the held page (NavePoint product page for 00404170 (navepoint-2u-horizontal-plastic-cable-management-raceway-4-inches-deep-black.txt, saved 2026-11-11)) gives "Dimensions: 19"L x 4.41"W x 3.5"H", Color Black, Material Plastic, Rack Units 2U, Number of Channels 1, Channel Cover Type snap, Channel Depth 4.1" and Cable Pass Through Yes. The installation manual the page links is not held. Everything inside the stated outer size (the plate and cover thickness, the walls, the clear opening between the rails) is estimated. No product photograph is held either, so no shape was checked and none was copied.

mount.note: estimated - the page says the raceway mounts on standard 19 in racks and ships four M6 cage nuts, screws and washers, and says nothing of which face. It is taken as a rack-face part that bolts to the rail face and stands out from it, as the other horizontal managers are.

rear.note: estimated - the back of the plate, plain. The page lists a cable pass-through and shows no place or size for it, so none is drawn (see `gaps`).

thickness.note: estimated - the plate 3.94 mm; see the back plate component.

top.note: estimated - an elevation, rear at the top: the plate, the wall seen edge-on and the cover across the front. The bottom is the same.

guides.source: NavePoint product page 00404170: Channel Depth 4.1"; the length is the opening between the rails and the height is the part's less two walls
